shared_elements: repeated motifs arranged in a horizontal row/register
row of rounded/lobed shapes along an upper band
justification: The only real correspondence is organisational: both surfaces carry motifs laid out in horizontal registers, with a row of repeated rounded forms along an upper band (red blob/handprint-like shapes in A, arch-and-figure units in B). Otherwise the depicted content diverges completely — A shows amorphous, non-representational painted marks with no identifiable creatures, while B shows a densely populated set of recognisable animals in profile (birds, a quadruped, a snake-like form) rendered as modelled relief figures with defined heads, limbs and eyes.
